reason: Every provider's chat usage, native mission usage and provider profile write signals the OpenRouter credit observer. Its scheduled check called refresh(), which raises ValueError for non-OpenRouter profiles (and NotFoundError for a profile deleted after use was signaled), so a Core on a local or OpenAI-compatible model logged a butler.openrouter_credit_check_failed ERROR after every completed chat turn. The scheduled path now returns quietly for a missing or non-OpenRouter profile, matching the harness quota observer. Selected: the Butler credit observer tests that pass on main plus the new regression test, and the provider credit reader/route tests.
exclusions: test_butler_resources.py::test_ordinary_openrouter_completion_checks_credits_after_exchange_commit and ::test_native_mission_attempt_usage_signals_account_check_after_commit are excluded because they fail identically on pristine origin/main (their observers are an async function and a lambda calling the async store.get, so the synchronous listener contract never records them); this change does not touch either path. No UI, native or Playwright cases: no frontend code changed and the defect is a background Core diagnostic. Real-Core evidence (scratch Postgres Core, 6 projects, stub OpenAI-compatible model: one ERROR per completed turn on main, zero across 12 turns with this patch) is recorded in the PR, not executed by CI.
